subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ards_only: all patients met Berlin moderate-to-severe ARDS (PaO2/FiO2 ≤ 150). obesity_subgroup: median BMI 29 (26–32) kg/m2, below the ≥30 threshold and obesity was not an enrolment criterion, but the IQR spans 30, so mixed rather than non_obese. timing_subgroup: median 4 (3–6) days of mechanical ventilation before study, i.e. balloon guidance began >48 h after intubation. ptp_target_subgroups: PEEP titrated to end-expiratory PTP 0–2 cmH2O using absolute Pes subtraction (airway pressure − Peso).

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: The paper explicitly states: 'Of these, forty patients had also been enrolled in a prior study [8], but with a different research question and study protocol.' Reference 8 is Boesing et al., Crit Care 2022;26:82 (boesing_2022). Same institution (University Medical Center Mannheim), same registration DRKS00017449 (registered June 27, 2019), enrolment July 2019–June 2023 overlapping the earlier report. COHORTS.md suspected a mannheim_boesing cluster between boesing_2022 and boesing_2024a and described boesing_2024b as a VV-ECMO population; the present report is an ARDS prone-positioning physiologic study, not ECMO, so the COHORTS.md description of 2024b does not match this PDF and needs adjudication. Overlap with boesing_2022 is confirmed from the text; overlap with boesing_2024a could not be checked from this report alone.
unclear_items: citation.is_primary_report: this 55-patient report shares 40 patients with boesing_2022 (n=40); which report of the shared Mannheim cohort is 'primary' needs adjudication — set true here as the larger, later report.

extraction_flags.cohort_id: COHORTS.md describes boesing_2024b as a VV-ECMO population, which contradicts this ARDS/prone-positioning report; the cluster assignment follows the explicit 40/55 overlap statement instead.

outcomes[].timepoint: the schema provides one timepoint per outcome entry, but this three-condition crossover reports baseline/supine/prone in single table rows; conditions were combined in data[] with timepoint.type crossover_condition and sequence noted in label_verbatim, rather than splitting each parameter into three separate outcome entries.

outcomes (lung elastic dynamic power, prone): prone-condition median/IQR for lung elastic dynamic power and its EELV-normalised counterpart appear only in Fig. 4 boxplots; values not numerically reported, so prone data values are null while the figure P values (0.002 and <0.001 vs baseline) are recorded.
design.randomised: the condition sequence was fixed (baseline → supine Peso → prone Peso) and no randomisation of order is mentioned; left null rather than false.
population.covid19_population: viral pneumonia 51% but COVID-19 is not named; coded not_reported.
population.n_ards_severity: moderate vs severe split not reported.
feasibility: no placement success, measurement failure, or balloon-related complication data reported anywhere in the paper.
design.countries: Germany inferred from the institution address (Mannheim, Germany); not stated as a country of enrolment per se.
data_only_in_figure: Lung elastic dynamic power, prone condition median/IQR (Fig. 4A)
Lung elastic dynamic power normalized to EELV, prone condition median/IQR (Fig. 4B)
extraction_flags.general_notes: All Table 2 and Table 3 rows were recorded as one outcome entry per parameter with three condition data entries (baseline_table, supine_peso, prone_peso) and all three reported pairwise Wilcoxon contrasts as paired_effects. The baseline condition values serve as the pre-intervention comparator per the codebook ruling. Lung total/static/dynamic elastic power values come from the Results text and Figs. 2–4; the prone dynamic-power values are figure-only. Lung mechanical power has no dedicated domain and was coded under 'other'.
